verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's homepage says its "Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask," which suggests background agentic monitoring. That claim is a single marketing line with no documentation on how users configure or control such automations. The recurring warehouse syncs show background data movement, but they are not user-defined automations. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automations (triggers, schedules, actions), docs on how the background agents are set up and governed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
